-- UNHANDLED EFFECT --------------------------------- main.fango

Top-level values must be pure, but this one performs `Console`.

2| input = readLine()
           ^^^^^^^^^^

Make it a function, like `name() = ...`, and call it from `main`.

-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

The type annotation for `input` says it is:

    String

but the body I found is:

    Maybe Line

2| input = readLine()
           ^^^^^^^^^^
